name: EPIC 220497189
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 10.1 solar radii and 0.95 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,321 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.95 solar masses and 10.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,985 K at its surface.
